_readme: HyperEVM (999) seed pools. Run: SEED_POOLS=config/hyperevm.json ./scripts/seed.sh hyperevm [--broadcast]. WETH kind = the chain's wrapped-native WHYPE (weth9 0x5555..5555, from contracts/deployments/hyperevm.json); the seeder auto-wraps native HYPE if short. tHOOK/tUSDC are fresh MINT test tokens. priceAperB values are DEMO ratios (tUSDC is a test token, not a real quote). Real HYPE — amounts are DEMO-scale; size to the funded deployer balance before --broadcast. NOTE: big-blocks mode was only needed for the large DEPLOY txs; seed txs are small (well under 3M gas), so standard blocks are fine.
